title: 1.21.1 → 1.21.6 in one command, on two mods
text: One command, no hand edits, for 1.21.1 → 1.21.6 on this mod, and the same for a second mod.
result: Two NeoForge mods port to 1.21.6 with nothing written by hand and pass behaviour checks in the real 1.21.6 client: Notes 1.21 → 1.21.6 (13 errors to 0; its key, a saved note and its pinned-note HUD layer) and Zombie Apocalypse Addon 1.21.1 → 1.21.6 (9 to 0; its zombie AI). The new rules run in official names (layer API, drawString, saved data codec, saddle slot, owner reference); an accessor mixin now works in a mod with no mixins (the port adds the config); NeoGradle and Gradle follow the target; the Mixin check reaches NeoForge 21.6's renamed unit-test launch target. Both checks ran on the boat Linux host, hidden on Xvfb.
